LightningComponentBundle.description: Four-column footer on the deep neutral surface, with a bottom bar carrying copyright and the financial disclaimer.

property.name: sitePath
property.label: Site Path Prefix
property.description: Internal link prefix without leading slash. Example: finance

property.name: aboutText
property.default: A suite of financial calculators for modelling investments, loans and retirement scenarios. Everything is computed in your browser.
property.label: About Text

property.name: calculatorLinks
property.label: Calculator Links
property.description: Top categories only. Comma separated Label|url pairs.

property.name: legalLinks
property.default: Disclaimer|/legal/disclaimer, Privacy Notice|/legal/privacy, Terms of Use|/legal/terms
property.label: Legal Links

property.name: contactLinks
property.label: Contact and Social Links
property.description: Comma separated Label|url pairs. Replace the REPLACE_ME social URLs.

property.name: disclaimer
property.default: Calculations are illustrative only and do not constitute financial advice.
property.label: Financial Disclaimer
property.description: Editable by legal without a deploy.
